# Orange Way

> Orange Way is the private finance app for people who own Bitcoin. End-to-end encrypted on-device — the server cannot read balances, transactions, or category names. Built for non-technical Bitcoin households who want a real finance app (banks + cards + investments + sats in one view) without the vendor reading their numbers. "Monarch for Bitcoiners," in plain terms.

## Key facts
- Category: Personal finance / budgeting / net worth tracking (FinanceApplication)
- Audience: Non-technical individuals and households who hold meaningful Bitcoin
- Pricing: $17.99/month or $100/year. Beta members lock in $100/year for life.
- Beta access: Apply at https://orangeway.app/beta
- Platform: Web app (works on desktop and mobile browsers). PWA-ready.
- Authentication: Email + password, Google sign-in. Vault data wrapped with on-device Argon2id-derived key.
- Encryption: AES-GCM data keys, wrapped per-user with ML-KEM-768 (post-quantum) and signed with ML-DSA-65. Per-household scope keys with rotation and rekey jobs.
- Bitcoin: First-class sats/BTC display, xpub-based wallet sync (read-only), on-chain net worth.
- Households: Email-based invite flow with public-key wrapping. Members can be added, revoked, and rekeyed without server-side decryption.
- Open source posture: Self-hostable for developers (https://orangeway.app/self-host). Most users use the hosted app.
- Enterprise: White-label / SSO / custom domain available for Bitcoin-native firms (https://orangeway.app/enterprise).
